children: The American Petroleum Institute reportedly shows a build of 1.78M barrels of oil in U.S. commercial stockpiles for the week ending September 18, after inventories rose by more than 7M barrels in the previous week.

Gasoline inventories reportedly show a draw of 2.16M barrels for the week, distillate inventories reportedly also show a draw of 2.16M barrels, and Cushing inventories reportedly show a build of 2.08M barrels.
The Energy Information Administration is scheduled to release its weekly U.S. petroleum supply report on Wednesday, with the average of analysts surveyed by

forecasting domestic commercial crude stocks would fall by 500K barrels, while gasoline inventories were expected to remain unchanged from the previous week and distillate inventories wore forecast to fall by 500K barrels.
